actual_restore.remote_main_verification: Reported original successful ls-remote identity; not queried again by this review
actual_restore.transport: Local committed Git objects to another path on the same computer; not remote object-download success or another-machine recovery

science_preservation.verification: Original producer seals plus source/restore stat only; no scientific/media payload read or hash

cancellation_scope.reported_reason: No matching live process; assertion before process handle/open or termination
cancellation_scope.scope: Original observer outcome is preserved as reported; this review did not repeat it or inspect a live process

reviewed_archive_contract: Current completed receipt requires both clean HEADs at the delivery commit and fixed source origin before any archive writes.
Exactly eight named ordinary JSON/MD/Python files plus manifest are archived; existing names are rejected. Original historical reviews and scientific producer outputs are outside the mutation set.
Manifest inherits existing entries and appends eight ordinary metadata identities only; cached-set check restricts commit to these eight files plus manifest.
Normal push origin main and independent ls-remote verify the new commit. Restore uses explicit local source refs into origin/main, then ff-only merge; origin URL is not rewritten.
Restore hashes only the nine ordinary delta files. Clean source/restore and matching commit are required; no force, science, media decoding or repeated remote object download.
Every Git invocation disables automatic GC/maintenance. Git object I/O is separate from the wrapper scientific-payload read statement.
temporal_note: complete_local_restore.py records local restore success; root then normalized the ordinary final receipt by moving its preserved old error/failure_phase into previous_transport_failure. The archived failed receipt remains the original failure evidence; this review binds both actual final records rather than claiming the failed remote transfer succeeded.
limitations: Static archive review does not claim the final metadata archive commit/push has already executed.
Same-machine different-path recovery and remote commit-identity verification do not demonstrate successful fresh remote download on another computer.
